Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG/CAIQ scope for NebulaHealth we're compiling a compact sample set that demonstrates your personnel onboarding and separation controls. Could you please provide the following artifacts for a small cohort (3-5 employees) covering the last 12 months: 

- Background check redacted copies (hire-to-date)
- First-day security training records and completion timestamps
- Role-based access provisioning (initial grant) and any privilege escalations
- Deprovisioning logs for two recent leavers (timestamped)
- A short redaction manifest describing how PII was removed

Preferred delivery: single compressed bundle (zip) plus a short index CSV listing file names and employee role (redacted ids ok). If there are any scoped exclusions (contractors, contingent workers), flag them in the index.

Target delivery by end of week (Fri 11/27) would help keep the SIG intake on schedule. Let me know if you need an NDA or additional intake form.

Best,
Emma
